name: Aramis Hammerhand
summary: In Deathknell's chapel, Aramis Hammerhand trains the newly risen Forsaken in holy combat. The Holy Light can answer their call, but wielding it burns their decayed flesh and demands fierce discipline.

sections.title: A Beacon in Deathknell
sections.body: In Deathknell's chapel, Aramis Hammerhand guides Forsaken who hold fast to their former faith. Before the Scourge swept across the north, many people of Lordaeron answered the Silver Hand's call. Aramis survived the fall of Lordaeron, then rose into undeath. He kept the martial and spiritual teachings of his former life, and now guides others who refuse to surrender their devotion.

sections.title: The Agony of the Holy Light
sections.body: For the Forsaken, channeling the Holy Light demands fierce will. Its power burns necrotic flesh and stirs long-dead nerves into excruciating pain. Aramis teaches new paladins that faith means enduring that torment. He asks them to face the physical and spiritual costs of wielding a force opposed to their undead nature.

faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand trains Forsaken paladins in Deathknell's chapel in Tirisfal Glades. He guides the newly risen who seek holy combat.

faq.q: Can the Forsaken actually wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Yes. The Forsaken can call upon the Holy Light through willpower and conviction. Its radiant power burns and scours their rotting flesh even as it heals or strengthens them.

faq.q: Where can I find Aramis Hammerhand?
faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand stands inside the chapel at Deathknell, the Forsaken's starting settlement in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What quests does Aramis Hammerhand offer?
faq.answer: Aramis offers class-specific training to newly risen paladins, including A Difficult Path, Rediscovering the Light, A Light in the Darkness, Coming to Terms, and Continue Your Training.

faq.q: Why is a paladin trainer working for the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Before the plague, Lordaeron was the cradle of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Many newly liberated Forsaken remember their oaths and keep to their sacred calling despite their undead state.

faq.q: Does using the Light heal the undead in the normal way?
faq.answer: The Light can mend undead bodies and grant martial strength, but using it is excruciating. It awakens their senses, forcing them to feel the rot of their own bodies.

angles.text: As a Forsaken paladin, Aramis is your first mentor. He guides you through the pain and spiritual discipline of wielding the Holy Light in an undead body.
As an undead traveler, you can see in Aramis that undeath need not sever Lordaeron's heritage of holy warfare, though the path brings great suffering.
